digest.component_or_area: gen_env_registry script and environment variable discovery
propositions: Environment-read helpers absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS are silently skipped during scanning, causing their environment variables to be missing from docs/env-vars.md
Two operator-settable variables (REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE) are currently undocumented because _gate_str_pref lacks a registry row, despite being advertised in CLI help

A parameterized-shim predicate (functions whose os.environ key expressions reference their own parameters) can enumerate env-read helpers in a closed, enumerable way across the codebase (9 hits in 557 files)
Missing registry rows for parameterized shims must fail closed by raising UnregisteredEnvReadHelper, symmetrically with how unrecognized os.environ attributes already fail
The fix recovers two real keys in the registry (162 → 164 variables) and adds read_secret_env to the helper table, making JIRA_API_TOKEN's config.py reader visible to scan()
